model_role: First-line semantic leaf validation gate before disease classification

dataset_composition.positive_source: PlantVillage (14 crops, 38 classes, healthy & diseased) + RoCoLe coffee leaves
dataset_composition.negative_source: Imagenette-160 (10 diverse classes: vehicles, buildings, animals, tools, instruments) + synthetic UI screenshots, sky gradients, textures
dataset_composition.leakage_prevention: Strict SHA-256 deduplication across train, val, and test splits

safety_guarantees: Stops downstream inference when non_leaf is detected; does NOT claim 100% OOD detection; operates in tandem with image quality checks and disease classifier confidence.
